SessionStart.description: Initialize and verify environment: SDK version, API key, directories, and dependencies.
SessionStart.onError: echo '[ERROR] Environment setup failed. Please check SDK version and .env configuration.'

PreToolUse.description: Warn before overwriting or deleting protected files (wheel, plan, notebooks, sample data).
PreToolUse.onError: echo '[WARNING] Attempted to overwrite protected files. Operation aborted.'

PreToolUse.description: Run safety checks for risky bash commands (rm, sudo, pip install, jupyter).
PreToolUse.onError: echo '[SECURITY] Unsafe bash command detected and blocked.'

PostToolUse.description: Validate notebook outputs and ensure metadata consistency after tool execution.
Auto-format notebooks and run linting before commit (black, flake8, nbstripout).

projectInfo.name: Skills Cookbook
projectInfo.description: An educational cookbook showcasing Claude Skills API through progressive, interactive notebooks.
